Noah: Minimal flow:
```text
SSE stream => edge-translator => local webhook (POST)
```

Maya: Give them ranges, include assumptions (model size, caching hit-rate). Keep it one page.
Noah: Security checklist (short): KMS integration? yes; SAML SSO? yes; audit logs? configure local syslog forwarding; cert pinning? supported at edge. I'll drop a 1-page checklist.
ops-bot: Created ticket RL-88 for translator deploy and docs handoff (assignee: Noah).
